purpose: Rule-based mapping from customer inputs (house style + budget + space + priorities) to concrete staircase design recommendations.

budget_tier.label: Entry level
budget_tier.for: rental properties, basic new builds, functional replacements

budget_tier.label: Luxury bespoke
budget_tier.for: architect projects, statement pieces, curved/floating stairs

modern_minimal.reasoning: Clean architectural lines. Glass balustrade opens sightlines. Warm oak grounds the cool palette. Matt finishes avoid the plastic look of high-gloss.

default_spec.risers: painted MDF - warm off-white or matched to walls
default_spec.strings: painted string in the same tone as risers
default_spec.balustrade: 12mm toughened glass with polished stainless bosses
default_spec.finish: matt hardwax oil (Osmo Polyx or Fiddes) on all timber
default_spec.lighting: warm 2700K LED strip under handrail groove
default_spec.under_stair: open architectural if space allows; hidden-door storage if not

swap.balustrade: square-section black metal balusters at 99mm centres

entry.reasoning_change: Substitute engineered treads and metal balusters — maintains the palette at a fraction of the cost.

mid.reasoning_change: Full material spec, defer lighting to phase 2.

add.under_stair: open architectural volume with feature wall

premium.reasoning_change: Floating stair becomes the design statement.

add.treads: American White Oak 40mm with shadow-gap detail to risers

luxury.reasoning_change: Every detail curated for premium read.

override.balustrade: frameless glass to maximise light + sightlines

add.lighting: under-tread LED essential, plus wall lights

farmhouse.reasoning: Honest materials. The staircase reads as part of the house architecture rather than a designed object. Warm timber, painted structure, chunky proportions.

default_spec.treads: European Oak 40mm - character grade with knots
default_spec.risers: painted timber - warm off-white or heritage colour
default_spec.strings: painted string in the same tone as risers
default_spec.finish: hardwax oil on treads and handrail; satin paint on painted elements
default_spec.lighting: warm wall lights on the stairwell wall (not integrated LED)
default_spec.under_stair: painted panelled cupboards, or hallway bench with coat storage

swap.treads: pine treads painted or stained to look like oak

entry.reasoning_change: Pine base with the right paint palette still reads as farmhouse.

add.under_stair: custom panelled cupboards with beading detail

premium.reasoning_change: Craft details signal quality without breaking the honest-materials rule.

add.under_stair: boot room / cloakroom with bench, hooks, mirror

add.treads: wider treads suit the grander proportion

victorian_period.reasoning: Preserve historic character. Turned spindles, detailed newels, dark stain or heritage paint. A modern glass-and-oak staircase in a Victorian house is a design mismatch.

default_spec.stair_type: closed_string with cut string detail on the open side
default_spec.treads: hardwood (oak or pitch pine) - dark stained or clear-lacquered
default_spec.strings: cut string with visible step profile, painted or stained
default_spec.handrail: profiled hardwood mopstick or reeded oval
default_spec.balustrade: turned spindles - Victorian or Edwardian profile at 90-99mm centres
default_spec.finish: traditional wax, dark oil, or clear lacquer
default_spec.lighting: period-style wall sconces on the stairwell wall
default_spec.under_stair: traditional panelled cupboard door matched to hall panelling

swap.treads: existing treads sanded and refinished (refurbishment not replacement)

entry.reasoning_change: In period property, refurbishment is often more appropriate than replacement.

add.handrail: restored or heritage-copy mahogany or oak

add.treads: reclaimed period oak matched to original

override.balustrade: slimmer turned profile at same 99mm centres

industrial.reasoning: Timber warmth grounding steel structure. Black metal hardware. Exposed fixings are acceptable and often deliberate.

default_spec.stair_type: closed_string with visible steel bracket detail, or full steel stringer
default_spec.treads: oak or walnut 40mm - solid timber grounding the metal
default_spec.risers: matte black powder-coated steel plate, OR open riser
default_spec.balustrade: square black steel balusters, black cable, or 12mm glass with black fittings
default_spec.finish: matt hardwax oil on timber, matt black powder coat on metal
default_spec.lighting: exposed pendant over stairwell, under-tread LED optional
default_spec.under_stair: open (with metal shelving unit if storage needed)

swap.strings: closed string painted matt black instead of steel

entry.reasoning_change: Timber string painted matte black reads as industrial without the metalwork cost.

premium.reasoning_change: Steel spine is the industrial signature.

add.lighting: statement pendant becomes the room feature

luxury_contemporary.reasoning: Statement piece. Every detail deliberate. Materials, geometry and lighting all coordinated. Under-budget premium timber is a false economy here.

default_spec.treads: American Black Walnut, or smoked/fumed oak 40mm
default_spec.risers: matched veneer to treads, or open riser
default_spec.handrail: square walnut, or brushed stainless steel
default_spec.balustrade: frameless low-iron 12mm laminated glass with hidden fixings
default_spec.finish: matt hardwax oil or clear satin lacquer
default_spec.lighting: three-layer: warm ambient under handrail + task under-tread + feature stairwell pendant or void chandelier
default_spec.under_stair: sculpted open architectural volume, or feature wine display

entry.note: Luxury contemporary is not achievable at entry budget. Recommend stepping up to premium tier or shifting style to modern minimal.

mid.note: Marginal — most luxury contemporary specifications require premium+.

override.stair_type: curved is worth the premium in a large entrance

small_hallway.note: Style mismatch — luxury contemporary needs volume to work.

classic_period.reasoning: Formal proportions. Detailed but restrained joinery. Panelling continuity into the stairwell. Painted string with hardwood treads is the canonical spec.

default_spec.stair_type: closed_string with cut string on open side
default_spec.treads: hardwood (oak or mahogany) clear-finished or dark-stained
default_spec.risers: painted timber - warm off-white or heritage colour
default_spec.balustrade: turned spindles - Georgian or Edwardian profile
default_spec.finish: clear lacquer or wax on treads, satin paint on painted elements
default_spec.under_stair: panelled cupboard door matched to hall panelling

swap.treads: pine treads stained to look like hardwood

add.handrail: custom-profiled hardwood with volute at bottom newel

matches: most interiors as risers or strings
painted_mdf.note: Only use MDF for painted surfaces (risers, strings, panels) - never for wearing tread surfaces.

balustrade_selection_rules.recommend: frameless glass with polished stainless bosses
balustrade_selection_rules.reasoning: Maximises light and sightlines while reading as premium.

balustrade_selection_rules.recommend: square black metal balusters at 99mm centres
balustrade_selection_rules.reasoning: Achieves modern look at accessible price.

balustrade_selection_rules.recommend: turned spindles - Victorian profile at 90-99mm centres
square black steel balusters OR black cable OR glass with black fittings
balustrade_selection_rules.reasoning: Metal or glass with black hardware carries the industrial language.

balustrade_selection_rules.recommend: frameless low-iron 12mm laminated glass with hidden fixings
balustrade_selection_rules.reasoning: Cleanest premium read - no visible fixings.

balustrade_selection_rules.recommend: glass balustrade regardless of style if compatible
vertical spindles at max 99mm centres (100mm sphere rule)
balustrade_selection_rules.reasoning: Doc K child safety. Avoid horizontal rails or cable systems where possible.

under_stair_selection_rules.reasoning: Maximises useable volume in tight space.
Empty space reads as premium in generous entrances.

under_stair_selection_rules.recommend: hallway bench with coat storage above and shoe drawers below
feature wine cellar with glass door and integrated lighting
under_stair_selection_rules.reasoning: Statement feature that supports the luxury read.

under_stair_selection_rules.recommend: dedicated cleaning cupboard with charging point for cordless/robot vacuum
hidden-door storage with flush wall finish, or open architectural
under_stair_selection_rules.reasoning: Storage disappears or the space stays open.

under_stair_selection_rules.recommend: consider a small under-stair playhouse door + window if height allows
under_stair_selection_rules.reasoning: Very high emotional value for young families.

engine_workflow: 1. Capture house_style + budget_tier + space_context + priorities from user.
3. Apply budget_variants[budget_tier] modifications (swap / keep / add / note).
5. Filter balustrade_selection_rules[] by matching when conditions, take highest priority match.
6. Filter under_stair_selection_rules[] by matching when conditions.
7. Cross-check against avoid[] list for the chosen style.
8. Assemble final specification with reasoning and budget indication.
9. Present as 2-3 variants (default + one down-tier + one up-tier) so customer sees range.
